name: xseek-match
description: Cross-tracker release search and matching through Prowlarr

scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run test:browser
scripts.check:core: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/server/**/*.ts" "src/contracts/**/*.ts" "src/domain/**/*.ts" "src/parser/**/*.ts" "src/web/**/*.{tsx,ts,css}" "test/**/*.{ts,tsx}" src/search-history.ts src/search-input.ts src/qui-result.ts src/tracker-entry.ts src/integration-capabilities.ts src/version.ts playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts "scripts/*.mjs"
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/server/**/*.ts" "src/contracts/**/*.ts" "src/domain/**/*.ts" "src/parser/**/*.ts" "src/web/**/*.{tsx,ts,css}" "test/**/*.{ts,tsx}" src/search-history.ts src/search-input.ts src/qui-result.ts src/tracker-entry.ts src/integration-capabilities.ts src/version.ts playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts "scripts/*.mjs"
